about: Frame rules: an art-only mod cell with its own frames gives no false errors; art on a vanilla cell needs one row of the phase's frames, in every pick, line and block; a mod cell's art strips (every block) fit their phase, intermission and ej_end.
expect_mod_errors: Cell 1 monster_art.goblin.start.body: has 5 frames, one row here is 2
Cell 2 monster_art.goblin.loop.body: has 3 frames, one row here is 5
Cell 3 monster_art.goblin.loop.body line: has 3 frames, one row here is 5
Cell 6 monster_art.goblin.anal.loop.body: has 3 frames, one row here is 5

Cell 9 monster_art.goblin.ej.body: has 3 frames, one row here is 5
Cell 'ART FRAMES BAD ANAL': strip 'a5' (monster_art.goblin.anal.loop) has 5 frames, it needs 6 per row
